en.summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved is a ground-up remake of 2001's Halo: Combat Evolved campaign, developed in Unreal Engine 5 by Halo Studios and released July 28, 2026 — 25 years after the original. It marks the first time a mainline Halo game has launched on PlayStation 5, alongside Xbox Series X/S, PC (Steam and Windows Store), cloud, and day-one Game Pass, with cross-play and cross-progression across every platform.

guideSections.title: Operation: METEORITE — The New Missions
guideSections.description: Included with every edition, Operation: METEORITE is a new three-mission story arc set one year before the events of Combat Evolved, featuring Master Chief and Sgt. Johnson infiltrating a Covenant research vessel. It adds new locations, enemy variants, and weapons drawn from across the wider Halo series.

guideSections.title: What's In and What's Out
guideSections.description: Campaign Evolved is campaign-only — the original competitive multiplayer is not included. It does support four-player online co-op and two-player split-screen on consoles, plus gameplay-modifying Skulls for replayability. Premium and Collector's Edition owners received up to five days of early access starting July 23, 2026.
